post.description:
Durably accept a health report for asynchronous processing.
A successful response confirms that the report is safely queued, not that downstream health evaluation has completed.
Use the signal history and entity diagnostic operations to observe the resulting health state.
A later report for the same signal replaces its current observation while previous values and health states remain available in signal history.
Retrying the same logical submission with the same repeatability headers does not ingest the report twice.

parameters.description: Name of the entity represented by this diagnostic snapshot.

parameters.description: Health report payload. Must not exceed 32 KiB (32768 bytes).

Repeatability-Result.description: Indicates whether the repeatable request was accepted or rejected.

values.name: accepted
values.description: If the request was accepted and the server guarantees that the server state reflects a single execution of the operation.

values.name: rejected
values.description:
If the request was rejected because the combination of Repeatability-First-Sent and Repeatability-Request-ID were invalid
or because the Repeatability-First-Sent value was outside the range of values held by the server.

AggregationType.description: Strategy used to combine a set of health inputs. The service emits documented values; the open string form lets clients retain future named values.

values.name: WorstOf
values.description: Select the greatest-severity member health state, where severity order is Unknown, then Healthy, then Degraded, then Unhealthy.

values.name: BestOf
values.description: Select the least-severe non-Unknown member health state; Unknown is always excluded.

values.name: MinHealthy
values.description: Apply Healthy-count/percentage thresholds over included inputs: at or below the unhealthy threshold yields Unhealthy; otherwise at or below the degraded threshold yields Degraded; otherwise Healthy.

values.name: MaxNotHealthy
values.description: Apply non-Healthy-count/percentage thresholds over included inputs: at or above the unhealthy threshold yields Unhealthy; otherwise at or above the degraded threshold yields Degraded; otherwise Healthy.

AggregationUnit.description: Unit applied to threshold-bearing aggregation strategies. The service emits documented values; the open string form lets clients retain future named values.

values.name: Absolute
values.description: Thresholds are interpreted as absolute counts of included inputs.

values.name: Percentage
values.description: Thresholds are interpreted as percentages of included inputs.

timestamp.description:
Point in time whose entity configuration supplied `healthObjective`: the `timestamp` query parameter
when supplied, otherwise the current service time. Only the objective is resolved at this instant.

evaluationStatus.description: Whether the objective result is complete, inconclusive, or not configured.

healthObjective.description: Health Objective as a percentage of time the entity should be healthy.

allowedNonHealthyPercent.description: Percentage of measured time the objective allows the entity to spend Non-Healthy; `100 - healthObjective`.

actualNonHealthyPercent.description: Percentage of measured time — the summed `stateDurations` — spent Non-Healthy (Degraded, Unhealthy, or Unknown).

exceededNonHealthyPercent.description:
Percentage by which actual Non-Healthy time exceeded the allowance, relative to that allowance:
`max((actualNonHealthyPercent - allowedNonHealthyPercent) / allowedNonHealthyPercent * 100, 0)`.
Omitted when `allowedNonHealthyPercent` is zero because division by zero is undefined.

allowedNonHealthyDuration.description: Non-Healthy duration `healthObjective` allows over the measured time; the time equivalent of `allowedNonHealthyPercent`.

actualNonHealthyDuration.description: Duration spent Non-Healthy (Degraded, Unhealthy, or Unknown) within the measured time.

exceededNonHealthyDuration.description: Non-Healthy duration beyond the allowance; zero when the allowance was not exceeded.

isMet.description:
Whether the objective was met, judged using the exact values underlying `actualNonHealthyDuration` and
`allowedNonHealthyDuration` before response rounding. Omitted when the evaluation is not conclusive.
Comparing the rounded percentage fields instead can report a window that overspent its allowance as
having met the objective.
